mode.optimizer: laplace_k_criterion.find_joint_mode (damped full Newton, backtracking on Phi)
mode.sensitivity: best-of-starts Laplace; mode differences across starts recorded

research_question: Does a whole-model Laplace approximation of log p(X, Y_train | theta_c, c), with Z integrated out at each candidate's saved theta-hat, rank the true assignment above Support-only and Wrong on the same data?
not_claimed: a new automatic selection method; Oracle is a diagnostic reference that knows the truth
lineage: E-consistent per-column + PR #129 generic model (experimental prototype; not adoptable). PR #129 not merged; AF1/AF2 (#166/#167) Draft; AF3 unpushed

quantity.target: log p(X, Y_train | theta_hat_c, c) = log ∫ p(X, Y_train, Z | theta_hat_c, c) dZ (latent marginal likelihood at plug-in theta; NOT Bayesian evidence, NOT Schwarz BIC, NOT a Q value)
quantity.laplace: Phi(Z_hat) + (nK/2) log 2π − ½ log|H|, Z_hat = joint mode at fixed theta_hat_c, H = full nK×nK negative Hessian including the Y cross blocks
quantity.phi: independent implementation log_joint_parts: N(0, var_z I) prior with constant; Gaussian X with sigma^2 and 2π; Poisson −log x!; CMP2 −2 log x! and log-normaliser; Bernoulli Y over unordered train pairs i<j only; test pairs never enter
quantity.gradient_hessian: laplace_k_criterion.gradient / negative_hessian (existing), validated by finite differences of the independent Phi in Phase A
quantity.penalty: none: all candidate assignments have identical free-parameter counts

data.masks: AF2 / M1 build_masks(r); Y_train = regime mask; test pairs only for secondary held-out Y

assignments.theta: each assignment's own saved AF2 refit theta-hat (F, sigma, w0, w, var_z)

hessian: full analytic, symmetrised; logdet by slogdet and by Cholesky (agreement recorded); no ridge, no jitter; OK only if max|grad| <= grad_tol and H positive definite

importance_sampling.purpose: diagnostic of the Laplace error only (secondary)

heldout_y.plugin: mean Bernoulli log-lik of test pairs at Z_hat
heldout_y.laplace_predictive: mean log of E_q[p] with q = N(Z_hat, H^-1), 2000 draws, seed 1666000 + case_index
heldout_y.caution: Y prediction alone does not identify the X family

x_caution: all X entries were used to fit; any X log-likelihood here is in-sample, never 'held-out X'

primary_metrics.per regime: number of datasets (of 20 with both OK) with Laplace(oracle) > Laplace(support_only), and > Laplace(wrong); mean paired difference with bootstrap CI
primary_metrics.note: a post-truth diagnostic of discriminability, not a selection accuracy

secondary_metrics: decomposition of each paired difference into Δ Phi(Z_hat) [prior, X gauss, X true-Poisson cols, X true-CMP cols, Y] and Δ(−½ log|H|)
oracle vs auto_first / auto_last on datasets where the Auto assignment differs from Oracle
oracle vs support_only on datasets where the AF3 Z5 Q-score misselected at least one CMP2 column
IS-corrected Laplace and IS diagnostics (ESS, batch spread)
held-out Y plug-in and Laplace-predictive log score
statistical_unit: dataset (20 per regime); columns and models within a dataset are never independent units
failure_rule: a non-OK primary-start Laplace (NOT_STATIONARY, HESSIAN_NOT_PD, ERROR) is kept and reported; a paired comparison uses only datasets where both members are OK; exclusions counted; nothing is retried, re-seeded or ridged

reading_guide_predeclared.R1: Oracle > Support-only AND Oracle > Wrong in >= 18/20 datasets in both regimes -> the Laplace whole-model comparison discriminates in this setting
reading_guide_predeclared.R2: Oracle > Support-only in <= 14/20 in a regime -> not reliably discriminative there
reading_guide_predeclared.R3: if the sign of a paired difference differs from the sign of its Δ Phi in >= 3 datasets, the Hessian term is decisive
reading_guide_predeclared.R4: if best-of-starts or IS-corrected values reverse the sign of a primary paired difference in >= 2 datasets of a regime, the Laplace result is fragile there (IS read only where relative ESS >= 0.01)
